sources.title: Korea Electronic Travel Authorization (K-ETA)
sources.publisher: Korea Immigration Service, Ministry of Justice
sources.officialityEvidence: The Ministry of Justice immigration site publishes the page and links both the official K-ETA site and the Republic of Korea Visa Portal.
sources.supportingExcerpt: K-ETA is a system for nationals eligible for visa-free entry.

sources.title: Visa Navigator
sources.publisher: Korea Visa Portal, Korea Immigration Service
sources.officialityEvidence: The Ministry of Justice K-ETA page links visa.go.kr as the Republic of Korea Visa Portal.

sources.title: K-ETA Application Guide
sources.publisher: Korea Immigration Service, Ministry of Justice
sources.officialityEvidence: The page footer identifies the Korea Electronic Travel Authorization Center and Ministry of Justice of the Republic of Korea.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Nationals eligible for K-ETA, who wish to enter the Republic of Korea without a visa, must obtain K-ETA approval.
